scenario: LCON.2.6.1 integer determinism — modulo sign. `-7 % 3` is 2 (result takes the divisor's sign, Python semantics per LEXP.7.6), not -1 (C remainder, dividend's sign). Guard `(t.x % 3) == 2` gates the emit; fact_count 2 confirms the bit-exact value.
rules_ds:
schema T scope logical:
    x: Int key

schema Hit scope logical:
    d: Int key

rule r:
    T t where (t.x % 3) == 2
->
    emit Hit logical d: 0
